tools.name: fiperly_info
tools.description: Who Fiperly is: independent AI development in Germany. Analysis of AI, work and the economy, websites for businesses, Agent-Ready, book.

tools.name: leistungen_und_preise
tools.description: Fixed-price website packages for car repair shops and trades, estate agents, and the Agent-Ready audit for mid-sized companies, with what is included. Optional: lang (de|en), branche (werkstatt|makler|pruefung).

tools.name: analysen
tools.description: Topic pages (kipode.de) on AI, jobs of the future, labour market, economy, robotics, energy in Germany. Optional: query.

tools.name: kontakt
tools.description: Phone, WhatsApp, email, booking link for a 30-minute call and the free website check form. Does not send anything.

tools.name: website_pruefen
tools.description: Free instant Agent-Ready check of any public website, answers in German. Two scores: Grundlagen 0-100 (can ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Google find, read and understand the site today: HTTPS, robots.txt for AI crawlers, Schema.org, readable without JavaScript, sitemap, llms.txt, title/description

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.php" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: kontakt, website_pruefen · Private data: website_pruefen · Public sink: kontakt.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: kontakt, website_pruefen · Private data: website_pruefen · Public sink: kontakt

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
